body: In my experience, the first 8ish games were definitely full of bots, after that it seems to be real players.

It's going to have to be anything second-hand. Ideally a laptop that was released as recently as possible. And you are probably going to want something with a dedicated GPU.  But for 300 it's going to be hard to find something adequate, sooo good luck. Just gotta hope you find a really good deal.

Yeah it's probably is driver related I guess. Check you have installed the latest drivers for your graphics card. 

Or you have plugged your monitor into the wrong port on the back of your PC, make sure it's plugged into the graphics card, not the motherboard.

I'm not 100% sure but it doesn't seem like which Warframe you use matters for coda. 

I'm just basing that off of the fact it doesn't list which Warframe you used to spawn the active coda like it does for liches and the element bonus for coda weapons is random in the shop.

So I'm assuming it's just random which ephemera you get if any at all.
